Coleen Rooney Discusses Marriage Struggles and Reality Show

Coleen Rooney has admitted to considering a split from her husband, Wayne Rooney, amidst marital difficulties. The couple's lives are also the subject of a reality television show, "The Real Rooneys," which has been reviewed as a look into their Cheshire mansion. Reviewers noted that while the show may not be as "real" as the couple might wish, their self-deprecation is enjoyable.
